title.zh-TW: 新增 maxProseWidth 設定，寬螢幕文字自動限制行寬
title.en: New maxProseWidth setting automatically limits line width on wide screens

body.zh-TW: 在寬螢幕或全螢幕終端機（terminal，輸入指令的文字介面）裡閱讀長篇說明，視線往往得在螢幕兩端大範圍來回掃描。現在新增了 `maxProseWidth` 設定鍵，能將純文字解說限制在好讀的行寬上限，而需要寬度的表格與程式碼區塊則繼續維持全寬展開。⟦好比在展覽大廳閱讀解說立牌，文字簡介集中在適中寬度的立柱上，超寬建築圖與全景模型依然全幅展開，參觀時不再看得眼花撩亂。⟧
body.en: Reading long explanations in a wide or full-screen terminal (the text interface where you type commands) often means your eyes have to sweep back and forth across the entire screen. The new `maxProseWidth` setting key caps plain-text explanations at a comfortable line width, while tables and code blocks that need the width still expand to full width. ⟦Think of reading exhibit placards in a museum hall: the text summaries sit on columns of a moderate width, while oversized architectural drawings and panoramic models still unfold at full size, so you no longer get dizzy taking it all in.⟧

items.original: Added a `maxProseWidth` setting that caps the width of Claude's prose in wide terminals while tables and code blocks keep the full width

title.zh-TW: 遙測設定防護：忽略專案匯出變數並在啟動時明確提醒
title.en: Telemetry setting safeguards: project-exported variables are ignored with a clear startup notice

body.zh-TW: 接手別人的專案資料夾時，若裡面的設定檔偷偷塞了遙測（telemetry，收集運作數據回傳伺服器的機制）變數，資料可能在不知情下外流。專案與本機設定檔現在會忽略開啟匯出、指定端點或擷取內容的 OpenTelemetry 變數，例如 `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` 與 `OTEL_LOG_*`。啟動畫面、`/status` 與 `claude doctor` 會列出專案設定檔中被忽略的遙測變數，也會列出使遙測關閉的變數。⟦如同社區大樓管理委員會規定住戶不能擅自加裝公共監控，即便租約手冊寫了偷錄條款，門禁主機也會直接無視並在警衛室亮燈提醒。⟧
body.en: When you take over someone else's project folder, if its config files quietly include telemetry (a mechanism that collects operational data and sends it back to a server) variables, your data could leak without your knowledge. Project and local config files now ignore OpenTelemetry variables that enable exporting, set endpoints, or capture content, such as `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` and `OTEL_LOG_*`. The startup screen, `/status`, and `claude doctor` list the telemetry variables ignored in project config files, as well as the variables that keep telemetry off. ⟦Like an apartment building's management committee that forbids residents from installing their own public surveillance: even if the lease handbook sneaks in a recording clause, the access-control system simply ignores it and lights up a warning in the guard room.⟧

items.original:
Added a startup notice, and `/status` and `claude doctor` entries, listing telemetry variables in a project's settings files that were ignored or that turned telemetry off
Changed project and local settings to ignore OpenTelemetry variables that turn on export, set its endpoint, or capture content, like `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY` and `OTEL_LOG_*`

title.zh-TW: 受管 MCP 專屬模式下允許啟用 Chrome 瀏覽器功能
title.en: Chrome browser features can now be enabled in managed-MCP-only mode

body.zh-TW: 企業在受管環境中強制鎖定 `managed-mcp.json` 工具設定時，原本想搭配 `claude --chrome` 讓 AI 操作瀏覽器會被直接擋下。現在新增了 `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` 受管設定鍵。企業管理員開啟後就能讓 Chrome 瀏覽器連線功能與專屬工具設定並存。要是瀏覽器功能遭到安全政策阻擋，終端機顯示的錯誤訊息也會直接指名是這項設定尚未開啟。⟦彷彿公司配發的專用筆電雖然鎖定軟體安裝清單，但總部發下特別通行證後，就能准許特定瀏覽器工具隨同專用軟體一起運作。⟧
body.en: When an enterprise locks down `managed-mcp.json` tool settings in a managed environment, trying to pair it with `claude --chrome` to let the AI operate a browser used to be blocked outright. A new managed setting key, `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp`, has been added. Once an enterprise admin turns it on, Chrome browser connectivity can coexist with the dedicated tool settings. If the browser feature is blocked by a security policy, the error message shown in the terminal now names this setting as the one that hasn't been enabled. ⟦Picture a company-issued laptop with a locked software installation list: once headquarters issues a special pass, a specific browser tool is permitted to run alongside the dedicated software.⟧

items.original: Added the `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` managed setting to let `claude --chrome` run alongside an exclusive `managed-mcp.json`; the error shown when Chrome is blocked now names it

title.zh-TW: 應用程式閘道新增資料庫故障轉移容錯寬限時間
title.en: Application gateway gains a fault-tolerance grace period for database failover

body.zh-TW: 部署在伺服器的應用程式閘道（gateway，轉發網路請求的中介伺服器）遇上資料庫短暫重啟或主從切換時，健康檢查往往會立刻報錯。閘道設定現在新增了 `store.readiness_grace_seconds` 參數。在 Postgres 資料庫短暫中斷期間，例如資料庫故障轉移時，健康檢查端點 `/readyz` 可以暫時維持就緒狀態。⟦就像大樓發電機在市電切換的短暫空檔啟動不斷電系統，警報器不會因為一瞬間的電壓波動就判定整棟大樓斷電。⟧
body.en: When a server-deployed application gateway (an intermediary server that forwards network requests) hits a brief database restart or a primary-replica switchover, health checks often report errors immediately. The gateway configuration now adds a `store.readiness_grace_seconds` parameter. During a brief Postgres database interruption, such as a database failover, the health-check endpoint `/readyz` can temporarily stay in the ready state. ⟦Like a building's generator kicking in its uninterruptible power supply during the brief gap of a grid switchover, the alarm doesn't declare the whole building dark over a momentary voltage flicker.⟧

items.original: Added `store.readiness_grace_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway so `/readyz` can stay ready through a short Postgres outage such as a database failover

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復與深度思考紀錄保留修復
title.en: Fixes for session resume and extended-thinking record retention

body.zh-TW: 處理長篇對話或延續舊工作階段時，多種可能導致思考脈絡遺失與請求失敗的問題已修復。使用 `--continue` 或 `--resume` 恢復工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期）時，早期訊息不會再因改寫重送而遺失先前的擴展思考。恢復對話時若透過 `--tools` 拿掉先前提過的內建工具，也不會再丟失思考紀錄。在 Claude 工作時執行 `/model`、`/rename`、`/artifacts` 或其他立即執行的斜線指令，也不再中斷思考紀錄。對話紀錄若含有 API 無法解密的搜尋結果不再引發 400 錯誤，這可能出現在經第三方閘道回答的回合。遇到 `redacted_thinking` 思考區塊資料無效時，Claude Code 會丟棄對話中的思考區塊後重試一次。關閉思考但強度設為極高時遇到安全切換也不再報錯。
body.en: Several issues that could cause lost thinking context and failed requests during long conversations or when continuing old sessions have been fixed. When resuming a session (the conversational cycle of interaction between you and the AI) with `--continue` or `--resume`, earlier messages no longer lose their prior extended thinking due to rewriting and resending. When resuming a conversation, removing previously mentioned built-in tools via `--tools` no longer drops thinking records either. Running `/model`, `/rename`, `/artifacts`, or other immediately executed slash commands while Claude is working no longer interrupts thinking records. Conversation history containing search results the API cannot decrypt no longer triggers a 400 error, which could occur on turns answered through a third-party gateway. When a `redacted_thinking` thinking block contains invalid data, Claude Code discards the thinking blocks in the conversation and retries once. Hitting a safety switch while thinking is off but effort is set to maximum no longer errors either.

title.zh-TW: 模型切換提示、額度購買與壓縮備援修復
title.en: Fixes for model-switch prompts, usage purchase, and compaction fallback

body.zh-TW: 切換模型與處理長對話摘要時，多項備援與提示機制已修正。長對話壓縮在摘要請求遭到拒絕時，現在會自動改用備援（fallback，主要方案失效時接手的替代方案）模型重新嘗試。在 Claude Desktop 等由 SDK 託管的工作階段中，未回應的額度購買提示不再擅自切換模型，而是直接結束該輪；遠端控制用戶端也會看到模型切換通知。用 `/model` 輸入 Fable 完整模型 ID，且方案需要尚未開啟的使用額度時，會正常彈出額度購買提示而非停在 API 錯誤。Bedrock 與 Bedrock Mantle 的安全攔截訊息現在會補上請求識別碼與訊息識別碼。Vertex AI 上遇到尚未登記的新模型也能正常提供網路搜尋，桌面版遇到未知模型時也會提示改選其他模型。
body.en: Several fallback and prompt mechanisms for switching models and summarizing long conversations have been corrected. When a summarization request is rejected during long-conversation compaction, it now automatically retries with a fallback model (the alternative that takes over when the primary option fails). In SDK-hosted sessions such as Claude Desktop, an unanswered usage-purchase prompt no longer switches models on its own and instead simply ends that turn; remote-control clients also see the model-switch notification. Entering a full Fable model ID with `/model` when the plan requires usage that hasn't been enabled now properly pops up the usage-purchase prompt instead of stalling on an API error. Safety-interception messages from Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle now include the request ID and message ID. Unregistered new models on Vertex AI can still provide web search, and the desktop app now prompts you to pick a different model when it encounters an unknown one.

title.zh-TW: 多重視窗同時登入與憑證重新整理修復
title.en: Fixes for simultaneous multi-window sign-in and credential refresh

body.zh-TW: 在電腦上同時開啟多個編輯器視窗進行登入時，憑證更新不再互相衝突卡住。如果前一個處理序在重新整理憑證（credentials，驗證使用者身分的登入證明）途中被關閉或強制結束，其他視窗不會再卡在另一處理序正在重新整理的登入錯誤長達一分鐘。同時啟動的各個工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期）若剛好遇上登入重整，現在也會自動重試抓取組織安全政策。⟦猶如多人共用同一個置物櫃，前一位感應到一半突然離開，感應門鎖不會把鎖死一整分鐘，下一位走上前就能重新感應並順利開門。⟧
body.en: When signing in with multiple editor windows open on the same computer, credential updates no longer conflict and jam. If a previous process is closed or force-killed partway through refreshing credentials (the sign-in proof that verifies your identity), other windows no longer get stuck for up to a minute on a sign-in error saying another process is refreshing. Sessions that start at the same time and happen to hit a sign-in refresh now also automatically retry fetching the organization's security policy. ⟦Like several people sharing one locker: if the person ahead walks away mid-swipe, the sensor lock doesn't stay deadlocked for a full minute—the next person can step up, swipe again, and open the door smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed requests failing for up to a minute with an "another Claude Code process is refreshing it" login error after that other process was closed or killed mid-refresh
Fixed sessions started while another Claude Code window was refreshing the sign-in (common with several VS Code windows) not retrying their organization policy fetch

title.zh-TW: 受管設定與沙盒防護政策嚴格生效
title.en: Managed settings and sandbox protection policies now enforced strictly

body.zh-TW:
企業管理員在派發組織安全性原則時，設定解析邏輯變得更加穩固。管理鎖定鍵如 `disableClaudeAiConnectors` 或 `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` 若被不小心打錯布林值，安全性鎖定依然強制生效並在啟動時點名該鍵。`permissions`、`autoMode`、工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）與 `attribution` 區塊若包含無效欄位，其餘有效設定仍會正常套用。下列任一情況，`sandbox.excludedCommands` 會忽略專案及本機設定的項目：
```
受管設定或 --settings 設 allowUnsandboxedCommands: false
受管設定設 allowManagedDomainsOnly: true
```
Windows 與 WSL 的管理員政策（HKLM、`managed-settings.json`）若存在但無效或無法讀取，可由使用者修改的 HKCU 與 WSL `/etc/claude-code` 設定就不會套用。
body.en:
When enterprise admins distribute organizational security policies, the settings-parsing logic has become more reliable. If a managed lockdown key such as `disableClaudeAiConnectors` or `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` is given a mistyped boolean value, the security lockdown is still enforced and the key is named at startup. If the `permissions`, `autoMode`, worktree (a Git feature that lets one project have multiple parallel copies), or `attribution` blocks contain invalid fields, the remaining valid settings still apply normally. Under any of the following conditions, `sandbox.excludedCommands` ignores entries from project and local settings:
```
Managed settings or --settings set allowUnsandboxedCommands: false
Managed settings set allowManagedDomainsOnly: true
```
If Windows or WSL administrator policies (HKLM, `managed-settings.json`) exist but are invalid or unreadable, the user-modifiable HKCU and WSL `/etc/claude-code` settings will not be applied.

items.original:
Fixed managed settings ignoring a mistyped value for boolean lock keys such as `disableClaudeAiConnectors` or `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`; the lock now applies and startup names the key
Fixed managed `permissions`, `autoMode`, `worktree` and `attribution` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the rest of the block now still applies
Changed `sandbox.excludedCommands` to ignore project and local settings entries when managed settings or `--settings` set `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false`, or managed `allowManagedDomainsOnly: true`
Changed Windows/WSL managed settings so an admin policy that is present but invalid or unreadable (HKLM, `managed-settings.json`) keeps user-writable HKCU and WSL `/etc/claude-code` from applying

title.zh-TW: 規則檔案載入路徑與權限比對修復
title.en: Fixes for rules-file loading paths and permission matching

body.zh-TW: 啟動專案與執行命令時的權限檢查更加安全嚴謹。啟動時不再經由儲存庫符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）以 `..` 或 `/.vol` 類型路徑讀取 macOS 的 `/Network` 中的 CLAUDE.md 與規則，也不再列出指向 `/home` 的規則連結。設定檔中含有中段萬用字元 `:*` 的 Bash 權限規則現在全面生效，並會在啟動時提示比對規則。受管 `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` 下，儲存庫、使用者及 `--add-dir` 來源的技能與指令，還有技能目錄中的外掛 manifest，都不能再藉 `allowed-tools` 自行預先核准工具。遠端工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期）的背景工作單元重啟後，在恢復的權限提示上核准的指令不會再執行兩次，授權提示中的特殊字元顯示也已改善。
body.en: Permission checks at project startup and command execution are now safer and stricter. At startup, CLAUDE.md and rules in macOS `/Network` are no longer read via repository symlinks (shortcut files that point to another location) using `..` or `/.vol`-style paths, and rule links pointing to `/home` are no longer listed. Bash permission rules containing a mid-pattern wildcard `:*` in config files now fully take effect, with a matching-rule notice at startup. Under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`, skills and commands from repository, user, and `--add-dir` sources, as well as plugin manifests in skill directories, can no longer pre-approve tools on their own via `allowed-tools`. After a background work unit of a remote session restarts, commands approved on the restored permission prompt no longer run twice, and the display of special characters in authorization prompts has also been improved.

items.original:
Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules being read at startup through a repository symlink reaching macOS's `/Network` via `..` or a `/.vol`-style kernel path, or a rules link to macOS's `/home` being listed
Fixed Bash permission rules with a mid-pattern `:*` being skipped in settings files while `--allowedTools` honored them; they now work from every source, with a startup warning on how they match
Fixed a command approved on a restored permission prompt running twice when a remote session's worker restarted
Fixed repository, user and `--add-dir` skills, commands and skills-directory plugin manifests pre-approving their own tools via `allowed-tools` under managed `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
Improved rendering of unusual Unicode in permission prompts

title.zh-TW: 雲端同步技能的權限規則與同名外掛處理
title.en: Permission rules and same-name plugin handling for cloud-synced skills

body.zh-TW: 如果你的擴充功能剛好用了 `anthropic-skills` 或 `claude-ai` 這兩個名稱，載入結果可能跟以前不同。允許規則 `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` 與 `Skill(claude-ai:*)` 只涵蓋從 claude.ai 雲端同步的技能，不涵蓋僅使用同名的外掛或其他技能。這兩個命名空間下的本機技能資料夾、指令檔及工作流指令不再載入；同名外掛仍會載入，只是名稱撞到同步技能時會讓位。以這些名稱設定的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器不再列出技能或提示詞，但工具仍可用；若要恢復清單，可在 MCP 設定中替伺服器改名。⟦像兩份名單碰到同名項目時，一份讓出名稱卻仍保有其他內容；現在同名外掛會讓位給雲端同步技能，但外掛仍會載入。⟧
body.en: If your extensions happen to use the names `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai`, the loading results may differ from before. The allow rules `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` cover only skills synced from the claude.ai cloud, not plugins or other skills that merely share the name. Local skill folders, command files, and workflow commands under these two namespaces are no longer loaded; same-name plugins still load, but they yield when their name collides with a synced skill. MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers configured with these names no longer list skills or prompts, though their tools remain usable; to restore the listing, rename the server in the MCP settings. ⟦When two rosters hit a same-named entry, one yields the name but keeps the rest of its content: same-name plugins now yield to cloud-synced skills, yet the plugins still load.⟧

items.original:
Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:*)` and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` allow rules to cover only skills synced from claude.ai, not plugins or other skills that merely use such a name
Changed skill folders, command files and workflow commands in the `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` namespace to no longer load; a plugin so named still loads but yields name ties to synced skills
Changed MCP servers configured under the name `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` to list no skills or prompts (their tools still work); rename the server in your MCP configuration to list them again

title.zh-TW: 直連 API 時自動模式預設改用伺服器端分類器
title.en: Auto mode now defaults to the server-side classifier on direct API connections

body.zh-TW: 你透過 Anthropic API 直連 Claude，並關閉遙測時，會遇到這項預設變更。使用自動模式（讓 Claude 無需逐步詢問就自主執行工具的模式）時，工具操作預設由伺服器端分類器判斷。若不想採用這項伺服器端預設，可設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` 退出。⟦像店家把預設訂單改由中央櫃台處理，原本照預設送出的單會走新路線，顧客仍可取消這項預設。⟧
body.en: This default change affects you if you connect to Claude directly through the Anthropic API with telemetry turned off. When using auto mode (the mode where Claude runs tools on its own without asking step by step), tool actions are now judged by the server-side classifier by default. If you don't want this server-side default, set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to opt out. ⟦A shop reroutes its default orders through a central counter: orders sent under the default now take the new path, and customers can still cancel that default.⟧

items.original: Changed auto mode to use the server-side classifier by default on a direct Anthropic API connection when telemetry is off (`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` opts out)

title.zh-TW: 終端機畫面渲染、中日韓文字換行與排版修復
title.en: Fixes for terminal rendering, CJK line wrapping, and layout

body.zh-TW: 終端機介面在各種視窗尺寸與輸出情境下的畫面渲染問題已全面修復。以全螢幕啟動時不再有一瞬間的空白畫面閃爍。在一般視窗模式下，執行指令輸出時若同時刪除提示行，導致畫面縮短後仍高於終端機高度，輸出內容不會再錯位或亂成一團。程式碼差異比較中若中日韓文字元或表情符號換行重繪，最後一欄不再留下殘留的舊字元。設定了 `SessionStart` 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的專案，啟動時範例提示文字不會再閃爍消失。螢幕報讀模式、引述中的清單與長清單中，若程式碼區塊在清單項目開頭，或在引述內開頭，區塊頂部空白行也不會再被誤刪。
body.en: Rendering issues in the terminal interface across various window sizes and output situations have been fixed across the board. Launching in fullscreen no longer shows a brief flash of a blank screen. In normal window mode, when running a command deletes the prompt line at the same time and the screen shrinks but is still taller than the terminal height, output no longer shifts out of place or scrambles. In code diffs, when CJK characters or emoji wrap and redraw, the last column no longer leaves behind stale old characters. For projects with a `SessionStart` hook (a small program triggered when a specific event happens), the example hint text no longer flickers away at startup. In screen-reader mode, in lists inside quotes, and in long lists, when a code block sits at the start of a list item or at the start inside a quote, the blank line at the top of the block is no longer wrongly deleted.

items.original:
Fixed a blank screen flashing before the first frame when starting in fullscreen mode
Fixed garbled, misplaced rows in the non-fullscreen renderer after the screen got shorter while still taller than the terminal, e.g. deleting a prompt line while a shell command streams output
Fixed a stale character left in the last column of a diff when a redrawn line's CJK character or emoji wrapped to the next row
Fixed the prompt's example text flashing and disappearing at startup in projects with a `SessionStart` hook
Fixed screen-reader mode, quoted lists and very long lists dropping the blank lines at the top of a code block that opens a list item, directly or inside a quote

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入貼上、快捷鍵提示與配額回報修復
title.en: Fixes for terminal paste, shortcut hints, and quota reporting

body.zh-TW: 終端機的輸入操作與工具執行錯誤回報變得更加清楚準確。Bash 與 PowerShell 遇到硬碟配額（quota，儲存空間上限）已滿時，不再只回傳含糊的代碼 Exit code 1 並在暫存資料夾留下龐大檔案，而是明確說明空間不足。工具參數驗證失敗時，現在會一次列出該次呼叫的所有無效參數，不再每次只報一個。在工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期）貼上多行文字時，若貼上模式中途重置，不會再變成一行行被當作指令送出。含有 Tab 字元的歷史提示詞被叫出時，游標不再停在非末尾位置。Windows Terminal 舊版發送提示改為顯示 `ctrl+x ctrl+s`。讀取 PDF 失敗時，包含特殊字元的路徑能正常顯示，資料夾名稱若類似 `password` 或 `invalid`，也不會再誤導錯誤原因。
body.en: Input handling and tool error reporting in the terminal are now clearer and more accurate. When Bash and PowerShell hit a full disk quota (the storage space limit), they no longer return only the vague Exit code 1 and leave huge files in the temp folder; they now state clearly that space ran out. When tool argument validation fails, all invalid arguments for that call are now listed at once instead of reporting just one each time. When pasting multi-line text during a session (the conversation cycle between you and the AI), if paste mode resets midway, the lines are no longer sent one by one as commands. When a history prompt containing Tab characters is recalled, the cursor no longer stops at a non-final position. The send hint on older Windows Terminal versions now shows `ctrl+x ctrl+s`. When reading a PDF fails, paths with special characters display properly, and folder names resembling `password` or `invalid` no longer mislead about the cause of the error.

items.original:
Fixed Bash and PowerShell hiding a full disk quota behind "Exit code 1" and leaving large output files in temp
Fixed tool input validation errors naming only an unknown, missing or mistyped parameter when other parameters in the same call were also invalid; those are now listed too
Fixed pasted multi-line text being submitted line by line after the terminal's bracketed paste mode was reset mid-session
Fixed the cursor landing before the end of a prompt recalled from history when the prompt contains a tab
Fixed the send-now hint showing ctrl+enter on terminals that send it as a newline (Windows Terminal before 1.25); it now shows ctrl+x ctrl+s there
Fixed PDF page-read error messages: paths with accented or non-Latin characters now appear readably, and a folder named like "password" or "invalid" can no longer make the error name the wrong cause

title.zh-TW: 指令流程中途取消防護與外掛解除安裝修復
title.en: Mid-command cancel protection and plugin uninstall fixes

body.zh-TW: 執行各項指令與外掛管理時，取消操作與錯誤防護機制已獲修正。`/install-github-app` 在使用者取消後，不再繼續推送分支或儲存密鑰，而是立刻中斷並回報已完成的進度。在 Bedrock 與 Vertex 等平台執行 `/feedback`、`/bug` 或 `/share` 時，若在儲存途中取消，不會再強制寫入回報檔案。卸載外掛時若設定檔仍啟用該外掛或無法讀取，系統會停止解除安裝並指出該檔案，不再謊報成功或刪除設定。卸載後若讀不到外掛清單，已儲存的選項與機密資訊仍會保留，解除安裝也會告知使用者已保留這些資料。`claude remote-control --debug` 不再因為參數未識別而報錯。
body.en: Cancel handling and error safeguards when running commands and managing plugins have been corrected. After you cancel, `/install-github-app` no longer keeps pushing the branch or saving the key; it stops immediately and reports the progress already completed. When running `/feedback`, `/bug`, or `/share` on platforms like Bedrock and Vertex, canceling midway through saving no longer force-writes the report file. When uninstalling a plugin, if the config file still enables that plugin or can't be read, the system stops the uninstall and points out that file, instead of falsely reporting success or deleting settings. If the plugin list can't be read after uninstalling, your saved options and secret information are still kept, and the uninstall tells you this data was preserved. `claude remote-control --debug` no longer errors out over an unrecognized argument.

items.original:
Fixed `claude remote-control --debug` failing with "Unknown argument: --debug", although Remote Control's own eligibility error says to run with `--debug`
Fixed `/install-github-app` saying "cancelled" and then still pushing the branch and saving the API key secret; leaving now stops the remaining steps and reports what was already done
Fixed /feedback, /bug and /share on Bedrock, Vertex and other third-party providers still saving the report file after you cancelled during the save
Fixed plugin uninstall reporting success and deleting the plugin's saved options when its settings file still enabled it or could not be read; it now stops and names the file
Fixed plugin uninstall deleting a plugin's saved options and secrets when the list of installed plugins could not be read after the removal; they are now kept and the uninstall says so

title.zh-TW: 技能清單面板搜尋、輸入游標與快捷鍵提示修復
title.en: Fixes for skills panel search, input cursor, and shortcut hints

body.zh-TW: 終端機選單與清單視窗的互動體驗修復了多處細節。全螢幕下 `/feedback` 草稿清單在滑鼠懸停時會顯示捲軸。在 `/skills` 中，緊接著 `/` 輸入的按鍵不會再移動技能清單，而會進入搜尋框。繼續輸入關鍵字時，打字游標也不再跳回清單本體，避免游標隱藏與輸入法輸入位置錯亂。非全螢幕下 `/skills` 與 `/mcp` 清單不再窄兩欄。代理面板底部按鍵說明在自訂長快捷鍵時不會再折成兩行，且收合提示會遵守自訂鍵設定。若在 `keybindings.json` 解除綁定停止所有代理的快捷鍵，`/tasks` 對話框底部不再出現多餘的分隔符號。
body.en: Several details of interacting with terminal menus and list windows have been fixed. In fullscreen, the `/feedback` draft list now shows a scrollbar on mouse hover. In `/skills`, keys typed right after `/` no longer move the skills list and instead go into the search box. As you keep typing keywords, the typing cursor no longer jumps back to the list body, avoiding a hidden cursor and misplaced input-method text. Outside fullscreen, the `/skills` and `/mcp` lists are no longer two columns narrower. The key hints at the bottom of the agents panel no longer wrap onto two lines with custom long shortcuts, and the collapse hint respects your custom key settings. If you unbind the shortcut for stopping all agents in `keybindings.json`, the extra separator no longer appears at the bottom of the `/tasks` dialog.

items.original:
Added a scrollbar to the `/feedback` drafts list in fullscreen mode; it appears while the mouse is over the list
Fixed a key typed right after `/` in `/skills` moving the skill list instead of reaching the search box
Fixed the terminal cursor jumping from the `/skills` search box to the skill list while typing, which could hide the caret and put IME input in the wrong place
Fixed lists with a scrollbar, such as `/skills` and `/mcp`, being two columns narrower outside fullscreen mode, where the scrollbar can never appear
Fixed the agent panel footer wrapping onto two lines with long rebound keys, and its "Esc to collapse" hint ignoring a rebound collapse key
Fixed a doubled ` · ` separator in the `/tasks` dialog footer when the stop-all-agents shortcut is unbound in `keybindings.json`

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式編輯指令與游標定位修復
title.en: Fixes for Vim mode editing commands and cursor positioning

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用 Vim 鍵盤模式時，多項編輯指令已校正為標準行為。`>>` 縮排指令不再對空白行增加縮排，`r` 帶數字時超出長度不會破壞文字，`2J` 不會多合併一行，最後一行的重複刪除與縮排（如 `2dd` 或 `2>>`）也不會位移異常或誤刪末行。使用 `dd`、`dj`、`dG` 刪除或用 `p`/`P` 整行貼上後，游標會落在第一個非空白字元，`yy` 複製不再意外移動游標，表情符號後按 Esc 也不會卡在字元內部。使用 `.` 重複 `x`、`s`、`p`、`d` 或 `c` 時能正確識別前置次數；上一行折行時，整行 `p`/`P`、`o`、`O`、`J`、`>>`、`<<` 等編輯指令也不再作用到錯誤行。從歷史紀錄叫出或從佇列拉回提示詞時，一般模式下的游標能精準落在結尾字元供 `x` 直接刪除。
body.en: When using Vim keyboard mode in the terminal input box, several editing commands have been corrected to standard behavior. The `>>` indent command no longer adds indentation to blank lines, `r` with a count no longer corrupts text when it exceeds the line length, `2J` no longer merges one extra line, and repeated deletes and indents on the last line (like `2dd` or `2>>`) no longer shift oddly or delete the final line by mistake. After deleting with `dd`, `dj`, or `dG`, or pasting whole lines with `p`/`P`, the cursor lands on the first non-blank character; `yy` yanking no longer moves the cursor unexpectedly, and pressing Esc after an emoji no longer gets stuck inside the character. Using `.` to repeat `x`, `s`, `p`, `d`, or `c` now correctly recognizes a preceding count; when the previous line is wrapped, whole-line editing commands like `p`/`P`, `o`, `O`, `J`, `>>`, and `<<` no longer act on the wrong line. When recalling a prompt from history or pulling it back from the queue, the cursor in normal mode lands precisely on the final character so `x` can delete it directly.

items.original:
Fixed vim mode `>>` indenting empty lines, `r` with a count longer than the line changing text, `2J` joining one line too many, and a count on the last line (`2dd`, `2>>`) shifting or deleting it
Fixed vim mode cursor placement: after `dd`, `dj`, `dG` or a whole-line `p`/`P` it lands on the first non-blank, `yy` no longer moves it, and Esc after an emoji no longer leaves it inside the emoji
Fixed vim mode ignoring a count typed before `.` when repeating `x`, `s`, `p`, `d` or `c`, and whole-line `p`/`P`, `o`, `O`, `J`, `>>` and `<<` acting on the wrong line when a line above wraps
Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a prompt recalled from history or pulled back from the queue in normal mode, so `x` did nothing

title.zh-TW: 超長工作階段恢復加速與產物面板改進
title.en: Faster resume of very long sessions and artifacts panel improvements

body.zh-TW: 延續超長對話與管理產物檔案的操作體驗更加順暢。恢復龐大工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期）的載入速度顯著加快，包含從未壓縮過的長對話紀錄。Windows 環境下若因檔案讀取失敗（EBADF）無法恢復對話，錯誤訊息會詳細列出可能原因與排除建議。發布產物時，若版本標籤超過 60 個字元會自動縮短，避免發布失敗。`/artifacts` 面板排版全面優化，標題整齊排列在單一欄位，放不下的說明內容會整項省略，而非從字中截斷；清單也支援 PgUp/PgDn、Home/End、滑鼠滾輪與點擊操作。
body.en: Continuing very long conversations and managing artifact files is now smoother. Loading speed when resuming a huge session (the conversation cycle between you and the AI) is significantly faster, including long conversation histories that have never been compacted. On Windows, if a conversation can't be resumed because of a file read failure (EBADF), the error message now lists possible causes and troubleshooting suggestions in detail. When publishing an artifact, version labels longer than 60 characters are automatically shortened to avoid publish failures. The `/artifacts` panel layout has been overhauled: titles line up neatly in a single column, and descriptions that don't fit are omitted as a whole item instead of being cut off mid-word; the list also supports PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, and click actions.

items.original:
Improved the time to resume very large sessions, including ones that were never compacted
Improved the error shown on Windows when a session can't be resumed because its transcript file could not be read (EBADF): it now names possible causes and what to try
Fixed artifact publishes failing when Claude gave the version a label longer than 60 characters; the label is now shortened
Improved `/artifacts`: titles line up in one column, details are dropped whole instead of cut mid-word, and the list supports PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, the mouse wheel and clicks

title.zh-TW: Claude API 開發指引更新與介面視覺調整
title.en: Claude API guidance updates and interface visual tweaks

body.zh-TW: 內建的 `claude-api` 技能更新了模型計費與受管代理資源管理的最新規範。技能文件新增拒絕回答計費說明的連結：輸出前拒絕會計入速率限制，串流中途拒絕則照常計費。文件中推薦使用 `ant apply` 將 Managed Agents 受管資源納入版本控制管理。介面視覺方面，`/effort` 與輸入框的 `ultracode` 樣式簡化為乾淨的樸素風格，去除了波紋、外框裝飾與關鍵字微光；dynamic-workflows 的轉圈提示也已移除。終端機啟動橫幅中的吉祥物 Clawd 雙腳位置也調整至身體邊角下方。
body.en: The built-in `claude-api` skill has been updated with the latest rules for model billing and managed agent resource management. The skill documentation adds a link explaining refusals in billing: refusing before output counts toward rate limits, while refusing mid-stream is billed as usual. The docs recommend using `ant apply` to bring Managed Agents managed resources under version control. On the visual side, the `ultracode` styling of `/effort` and the input box has been simplified to a clean, plain look, removing the ripples, border decorations, and keyword shimmer; the spinning indicator for dynamic-workflows has also been removed. The mascot Clawd's feet in the terminal startup banner have been repositioned below the corners of its body.

items.original:
Updated the `claude-api` skill: pre-output refusal billing now links to the How refusals are billed docs, mid-stream refusals bill at normal rates, and pre-output refusals count against rate limits
Updated the `claude-api` skill to recommend `ant apply` for keeping Managed Agents resources as version-controlled files
Changed the `ultracode` visuals in `/effort` and the prompt input to plain styling (no ripple, border flourish or keyword glimmer) and removed the dynamic-workflows spinner tip
Changed the Clawd mascot's feet in the start-up banner to sit under the corners of his body

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件長回覆串流效能與連線介面修復
title.en: VS Code extension long-reply streaming performance and connection UI fixes

body.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件在長篇對話與視窗整合上的多個問題已修復。生成長回覆時，面板不再於每次字元更新時重新解析全部文字，改善了回覆內容跟不上串流速度的延遲卡頓。訊息輸入框增高出現捲軸時，語音輸入麥克風按鈕不再遮擋住捲軸。在本機發起的遠端控制工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期），現在能從 Web 清單項目點開本機對話，除非工作階段正在別處執行。擴充套件主機重啟後，編輯器分頁中的登入畫面若卡住，會顯示「停止回應」通知。
body.en: Several issues in the VS Code extension around long conversations and window integration have been fixed. When generating long replies, the panel no longer re-parses the entire text on every character update, improving the laggy stutter where reply content couldn't keep up with the stream. When the message input box grows tall enough to show a scrollbar, the voice input microphone button no longer covers the scrollbar. For a remote-control session (the conversation cycle between you and the AI) started locally, you can now open the local conversation from the Web list item, unless the session is running elsewhere. After the extension host restarts, if the sign-in screen in an editor tab gets stuck, an "unresponsive" notification is shown.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed long replies falling behind the stream: the panel no longer re-parses the whole reply on every update
[VSCode] Fixed the dictation mic button covering the message input's scrollbar when the input is tall enough to scroll
[VSCode] Fixed Remote Control sessions started on this computer not opening from their Web entry in the session list; they now open the local conversation unless it's running elsewhere
[VSCode] Fixed an editor tab's sign-in screen hanging silently after the extension host restarts; it now shows the "stopped responding" notice too

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段儲存庫連接與排程管理改進
title.en: Cloud session repository connection and schedule management improvements

body.zh-TW: 在跨平台環境管理雲端任務時，若需要查看關聯的程式碼庫或確認定期排程時間，多項介面操作已獲加強。GitHub 連接器設定頁現在會顯示 GitHub App 的安裝與連線狀態，並提供連接、安裝或重新連接的步驟。儲存庫託管在非 GitHub 的 Git 伺服器時，雲端工作階段的儲存庫選單新增了開啟儲存庫與開啟版本比較頁面的捷徑。已有一個儲存庫的執行中工作階段（session，使用者與 AI 互動的對話週期）現在可以掛載來自不同 GitHub 擁有者的儲存庫，包含從 Slack 啟動的工作階段，方便對照上游專案。修復了半小時時區每小時例行排程下次執行時間偏差 30 分鐘的問題。大量排定檢查提醒的帳號在載入 Routines 頁面與側邊欄排程清單時速度明顯加快。
body.en: When managing cloud tasks across platforms, several interface operations have been strengthened for viewing associated codebases or confirming recurring schedule times. The GitHub connector settings page now shows the GitHub App's installation and connection status, with steps to connect, install, or reconnect. When a repository is hosted on a non-GitHub Git server, the cloud session's repository menu adds shortcuts to open the repository and open the version comparison page. A running session (the conversation cycle between you and the AI) that already has one repository can now attach repositories from different GitHub owners, including sessions started from Slack, making it easy to compare against upstream projects. Fixed an issue where the next run time of an hourly recurring schedule in a half-hour time zone was off by 30 minutes. Accounts with large numbers of scheduled check reminders now load the Routines page and the sidebar schedule list noticeably faster.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added Claude GitHub App status to Settings › Connectors › GitHub: whether the app is installed and reachable for your account, plus steps to connect, install or reconnect
[Cloud sessions] Added "Open repository" and "Open compare page" links to the repository menu of a cloud session whose repository is hosted on a Git server other than GitHub
[Cloud sessions] Added attaching a repository from a different GitHub owner, such as a fork's upstream, to a running cloud session that already has one, including sessions started from Slack
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the next run time shown for an hourly routine being 30 minutes off for people in half-hour-offset time zones such as India
[Cloud sessions] Improved how quickly the Routines page and the sidebar's Scheduled list load for accounts whose past sessions scheduled many check-in reminders

title.zh-TW: Slack 企業網格頻道共享與權限設定修復
title.en: Slack Enterprise Grid Channel Sharing and Permission Setup Fixes

body.zh-TW: 跨部門使用 Slack 多工作區架構協作時，團隊常會遇到機器人沒有自動加入新頻道或無法正常回覆的情況。企業全組織安裝時，單一工作區設定的頻道自動加入規則不再被忽略，Claude 會正常加入符合條件的新頻道。在同組織不同工作區共享的頻道中，Claude 不會再因為版本設定來自另一工作區而沉默不語。若頻道共享給尚未安裝 Claude 的工作區，提示訊息會明確指出是哪一個工作區需要安裝，不再只回報無法檢查頻道。中斷 GitHub 組織連線後，從權限套裝中移除該授權能順利儲存。舊版 Slack 應用程式連接 GitHub Enterprise Server 時，進度卡片現在會正確顯示儲存庫名稱並提供有效的建立 PR 按鈕。
body.en: When teams collaborate across departments using Slack's multi-workspace architecture, they often run into situations where the bot fails to auto-join new channels or cannot reply properly. With an org-wide enterprise installation, channel auto-join rules configured for a single workspace are no longer ignored, and Claude joins qualifying new channels as expected. In channels shared between different workspaces of the same organization, Claude no longer stays silent just because its version setting comes from another workspace. If a channel is shared with a workspace that has not installed Claude yet, the prompt message now clearly states which workspace needs the installation, instead of only reporting that the channel cannot be checked. After disconnecting a GitHub organization, removing that authorization from a permission bundle now saves successfully. When a legacy Slack app connects to GitHub Enterprise Server, the progress card now correctly shows the repository name and provides a working Create PR button.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed auto-join channel patterns saved for one workspace in Claude Tag admin settings being ignored on an Enterprise Grid org-wide install; Claude now joins matching new channels
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not responding in an Enterprise Grid channel shared between two workspaces of one organization when the channel's Claude Tag version was saved from the other workspace
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude always replying "Couldn't check this channel just now" in a channel shared with a Grid workspace it isn't added to; the notice now says which workspace needs the app
[Claude Tag] Fixed removing a GitHub organization's grant from an access bundle's Repositories tab in Claude Tag admin settings failing to save after that GitHub organization was disconnected
[Claude Tag] Fixed the earlier Claude in Slack app's progress card for sessions on a GitHub Enterprise Server repository: it now names the repository and offers a working Create PR button

title.zh-TW: Slack 訊息版面、模型遷移與用量顯示修復
title.en: Slack Message Layout, Model Migration, and Usage Display Fixes

body.zh-TW: Slack 內部對話的模型切換與訊息呈現進行了多項優化。當討論串原本使用的舊模型下線時，討論串會直接遷移至可用模型，不再於每次回覆時以較慢的備援（fallback，主要方案失效時接手的替代方案）模型重試並跳出提示。Claude 上傳至 Slack 的檔案說明現在支援表格排版，格式與一般回覆一致。Agents & tools 清單不再把討論串首則訊息誤當名稱，後續重新命名也會同步更新。工作階段的雲端工作單元重啟後，回覆底部的費用與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計量不再膨脹數倍。回覆中的計畫、表格與細節外框卡片預設改用寬版呈現，新連接的 Slack 工作區也會跟隨目前預設模型的變動。
body.en: Model switching and message rendering in Slack internal conversations received several improvements. When the older model a thread was using goes offline, the thread migrates directly to an available model, instead of retrying with the slower fallback model on every reply and popping up a notice. File descriptions Claude uploads to Slack now support table formatting, consistent with regular replies. The Agents & tools list no longer mistakes a thread's first message for its name, and later renames sync as well. After a session's cloud work unit restarts, the cost and token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) counts at the bottom of replies no longer inflate severalfold. Plan, table, and detail border cards in replies now default to a wide layout, and newly connected Slack workspaces also follow changes to the current default model.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads whose model has been retired falling back to another model on every reply, slower and with a fallback note each time; the thread now moves to a working model
[Claude Tag] Fixed files Claude uploads to Slack not being able to carry a caption containing a table; captions now render with the same formatting as replies
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's threads in Slack's Agents & tools view sometimes being listed under their first message instead of their name; later renames now update the list too
[Claude Tag] Fixed the cost and token totals in Claude's reply footer reading many times too high after the session's cloud worker restarted
[Claude Tag] Changed the bordered cards Claude uses in Slack replies for plans, tables and details to render wide by default instead of a narrow width
[Claude Tag] Changed newly connected Slack workspaces to follow the current default model instead of keeping whichever model was the default when they were connected

title.zh-TW: GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 模型上線，支援 Bedrock 並附帶舊版遷移提示
title.en: GPT-6 Sol and Luna Models Launch with Bedrock Support and Legacy Migration Tips

body.zh-TW: 如果你正準備挑選模型處理專案，現在多了 GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 兩款新模型可供切換使用。⟦就像工坊添購了兩台新設備，連接著企業專用線路的廠區能直接啟用，操作台旁還附上了舊機型的換機指引。⟧習慣透過 Amazon Bedrock（AWS 提供的雲端模型託管服務）串接模型的團隊，現在也能直接選用這兩款模型。如果手邊的專案仍在運行舊版模型，也可以參考附帶的遷移提示，順利將工作過渡到新模型。
body.en: If you're picking a model for your project, two new models, GPT-6 Sol and Luna, are now available to switch to. ⟦Picture a workshop that just added two new machines: the facility connected to the dedicated enterprise line can power them on right away, and a replacement guide for the old models sits next to the console.⟧ Teams used to connecting models through Amazon Bedrock (AWS's cloud model hosting service) can now choose these two models directly. If your project still runs on an older model, you can also follow the included migration tips to move your work over to the new models smoothly.

items.original: Added GPT-6 Sol and Luna, including Amazon Bedrock support and migration prompts for older models. (#47332, #47347)

title.zh-TW: 背景伺服器自動啟動，遠端工作階段支援匯入指令
title.en: Background Servers Auto-Start, Remote Sessions Support the Import Command

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟互動式工作階段（與 AI 即時交談的操作階段）時，符合條件的環境現在會自動在背後啟動伺服器。⟦彷彿走進智能廚房時備料烤箱就已自動熱機，以前每次動工都要先手動啟動各台設備，現在一進場就能直接開始；遇到設定規格不合時，控制台還會主動提供調整方案讓你點選修復。⟧萬一伺服器設定與當前環境衝突，畫面會給出修復選項供你選擇，避免操作直接中斷。在遠端連線或本機背景伺服器的工作階段中，你現在也能隨時使用 `/import` 指令。
body.en: When you open an interactive session (a live conversation with the AI), eligible environments now automatically start a server behind the scenes. ⟦It's like walking into a smart kitchen where the prep oven is already warming up: you used to have to manually start every machine before getting to work, but now you can begin the moment you walk in; and when the settings don't match the spec, the console proactively offers adjustment options you can click to fix.⟧ If the server configuration conflicts with your current environment, the screen offers repair options so your work isn't interrupted outright. In sessions running on a remote connection or a local background server, you can now also use the `/import` command at any time.

items.original:
Enabled automatic background-server startup for eligible interactive sessions, with recovery choices when server settings are incompatible. (#47179, #47318)
Made `/import` available in remote sessions and local background-server sessions. (#47317)

title.zh-TW: 快捷鍵快速分岔對話，草稿與語音通話切換不中斷
title.en: Fork Conversations with a Shortcut, Drafts and Voice Calls Survive Switching

body.zh-TW: 你正在與 AI 討論專案，如果想開闢新分支探索不同方案，這正是按下 `f` 快捷鍵分岔對話（從既有討論衍生新分支）的時刻。⟦會議室另開一桌討論時，草稿與排隊待談的問題會跟著到新桌；在兩桌之間換位時，耳機裡的通話則持續進行。⟧透過這項功能分岔在其他應用程式中開啟的對話時，你尚未送出的草稿與排隊中的提示詞都會完整保留。當你在不同討論串之間切換時，進行中的語音通話不會被迫中斷。如果在回合結束時你輸入框裡還有未送出的回答，內容會自動恢復到輸入框中，而且不會干擾當前進行中的歷史紀錄搜尋。
body.en: You're discussing a project with the AI, and if you want to open a new branch to explore a different approach, this is the moment to press the `f` shortcut to fork the conversation (spinning a new branch off the existing discussion). ⟦When a meeting room opens a second table for discussion, the drafts and queued questions follow you to the new table; and as you move between the two tables, the call in your headset keeps going.⟧ When you fork a conversation that was opened in another application, your unsent drafts and queued prompts are all preserved intact. As you switch between discussion threads, an ongoing voice call is not forced to disconnect. If you still have an unsubmitted reply in the input box when a turn ends, the content is automatically restored to the input box, without interfering with any history search currently in progress.

items.original:
Added an `f` shortcut to fork conversations open in another app, preserving drafts and queued prompts. (#47185)
Preserved active voice conversations when switching threads. (#47381)
Recovered unsent question answers into the composer when turns end, without disrupting active history searches. (#47422, #47423)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕對話紀錄預設開啟，終端機排版與選取捲動體驗升級
title.en: Fullscreen Conversation History On by Default, Terminal Layout and Selection Scrolling Upgraded

body.zh-TW: 當你需要在終端機裡查閱長篇回應、或是想跨行複製特定段落時，畫面空間與文字選取都很重要。對話紀錄現在預設以全螢幕顯示，並支援按住 Shift 鍵配合點擊來延伸選取文字。⟦跟把粗糙的黑白草稿換成排版講究的印刷手冊一樣，以前數學符號與清單容易擠成一團，現在符號排得整齊，也能拉著尺標連續標記整段文字。⟧畫面渲染也更加細緻，完整支援 Unicode（通用文字編碼）項目符號、核取方塊、對齊方程式與最佳化數學標記。當你在自動螢幕模式下透過 SSH（遠端連線通道）使用 Terminal.app 時，現在能再次使用原生捲動紀錄。終端機也會遵循 tmux（終端機多工工具）的滑鼠設定。
body.en: When you need to read long responses in the terminal or copy a specific passage across lines, screen space and text selection both matter. Conversation history now displays fullscreen by default, and supports holding the Shift key while clicking to extend a text selection. ⟦Think of swapping a rough black-and-white draft for a carefully typeset printed manual: math symbols and lists used to get crammed together, but now the symbols line up neatly, and you can drag along the ruler to mark an entire passage in one go.⟧ Rendering is also more refined, with full support for Unicode (universal text encoding) bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. When you use Terminal.app over SSH (a remote connection channel) in automatic screen mode, native scrollback works again. The terminal also respects the mouse settings of tmux (a terminal multiplexer).

items.original:
Enabled fullscreen transcripts by default and added Shift-click to extend text selections. (#47178, #47414)
Improved terminal rendering with Unicode bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. (#47191, #47322)
Respected tmux mouse settings and restored native scrollback for Terminal.app over SSH in automatic screen mode. (#47399, #47417)

title.zh-TW: 代理伺服器路由修復，檔案上傳支援重試並強化連線管制
title.en: Proxy Routing Fixed, File Uploads Gain Retries and Stricter Connection Enforcement

body.zh-TW: 在受管制或需要透過代理伺服器（替你轉發網路請求的中繼主機）連網的環境中，現在網路傳輸更加可靠且安全。⟦好比替物流轉運站加裝智慧閘門與重送輸送帶，以前遇到訊號微弱包裹就容易掉單、轉運路線也偶爾走錯，現在傳送失敗會自動重試且等候時間更長，遇到安全通行證被撤銷時也會立刻阻斷違規包裹。⟧過去即時連線與獨立網路搜尋在遇到轉址時，代理伺服器路由可能走錯，這個問題已經修好。上傳檔案時若遇到暫時性網路故障會自動重試，上傳逾時時間也延長至五分鐘。所有轉址與進行中的 HTTP（網頁傳輸規則）連線都會嚴格落實網路限制。WebSocket（即時雙向連線）也一樣；一旦安全規則變更撤銷了權限，連線會立刻被主動中斷。
body.en: In managed environments or ones that reach the network through a proxy server (a relay host that forwards your network requests), network transfers are now more reliable and secure. ⟦Like fitting a logistics hub with smart gates and a resend conveyor belt: packages used to get dropped whenever the signal was weak and transfer routes occasionally went the wrong way, but now failed deliveries retry automatically with a longer wait, and any package whose security pass has been revoked is blocked on the spot.⟧ Previously, live connections and standalone web searches could take the wrong proxy route when hitting a redirect; that problem is fixed. File uploads now retry automatically on transient network failures, and the upload timeout has been extended to five minutes. All redirects and in-flight HTTP (web transfer protocol) connections strictly enforce network restrictions. The same goes for WebSocket (a real-time two-way connection): once a security rule change revokes permission, the connection is actively terminated immediately.

items.original:
Fixed configured proxy routing for realtime connections and standalone web search, including search redirects. (#47101, #47142, #47204)
Added retries for transient file-upload failures and increased the upload timeout to five minutes. (#47122, #47393)
Enforced network restrictions across redirects and ongoing HTTP and WebSocket traffic, including cancellation when policy changes revoke access. (#47389, #47407)

entries: Improved reasoning effort level for models with different support, selectable with `--effort` or from the effort gauge in `/effort` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: 模型推理解析度支援分級，旗標與選單皆可自訂力度
title.en: Tiered Reasoning Effort Support for Models, Configurable via Flag and Menu

body.zh-TW: 當你需要模型處理繁複的架構設計或快速回覆簡短提問時，能自由調配思考深度就顯得格外實用。Antigravity 改進了不同模型對推理解析度（reasoning effort，模型產生答案前的思考運算深度）的支援，讓支援不同思考力度的模型能更精準切換層級。現在只要在啟動指令加上 `--effort` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/effort` 與 `/model`，就能從視覺化量表直接挑選適合的強度。⟦就像騎變速自行車依路況切換檔位，遇到陡峭山路時切換到高檔全力衝刺，平坦直路則換上輕檔快速巡航。⟧ 遇到棘手的重構難題時拉高力度，寫簡短測試或整理資料時調低檔位，思考資源運用更靈活。
body.en: When you need a model to tackle complex architectural designs or quickly answer brief questions, the freedom to adjust thinking depth is especially useful. Antigravity improves support for reasoning effort across different models, allowing models with varying reasoning capabilities to switch levels more precisely. You can now select the right intensity directly from a visual gauge by adding the `--effort` flag to startup commands or running `/effort` and `/model` during a session. ⟦Like shifting gears on a bicycle to match the terrain, a rider shifts into a higher gear for full power on steep climbs and cruises in a lighter gear on flat roads.⟧ Dial up the effort for tricky refactoring tasks and lower it for short tests or data organization, making your thinking resources far more flexible.

items.original: Improved reasoning effort level for models with different support, selectable with `--effort` or from the effort gauge in `/effort` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: 需要設定參數的手動外掛改為預設停用
title.en: Manually Added Plugins That Need Configuration Now Start Disabled

body.zh-TW: 平時若是習慣直接把擴充套件檔案複製到設定資料夾，要注意這些外掛的啟用方式變了。以前直接放進 `~/.gemini/config/plugins` 目錄的外掛，只要內含需要設定參數的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，往往一放進去就嘗試運作；現在它們預設會先保持停用，直到你主動啟用為止。這樣的行為已與透過 `/plugin` 指令安裝的外掛完全一致。⟦如同收到需要裝上電池才能運轉的新家電，出廠時預設切在斷電安全檔，一定要先裝妥配件並手動按下開關才會啟動。⟧
body.en: If you usually copy plugin files directly into the configuration folder, note that these plugins now start up differently. Previously, plugins placed directly in the `~/.gemini/config/plugins` directory would attempt to run immediately if they contained MCP servers requiring configuration parameters; now, they remain disabled by default until you explicitly enable them. This behavior now fully matches plugins installed via the `/plugin` command. ⟦Picture receiving a new household appliance that requires batteries: it arrives safely switched off by default, starting up only after you install the accessories and manually turn on the power switch.⟧

items.original: Changed plugins placed directly in `~/.gemini/config/plugins` so that a plugin whose MCP server needs configuration variables now starts disabled until you enable it, matching plugins installed through `/plugin`.

title.zh-TW: WezTerm 與 VS Code 終端機不再破圖，圖表改以純文字備援顯示
title.en: No More Garbled Graphics in WezTerm and VS Code, Falling Back to Plain Text Diagrams

body.zh-TW: 在 WezTerm 或 VS Code 內建終端機裡查看架構圖或數學公式時，畫面上不再出現一連串令人摸不著頭緒的亂碼方塊。過去輸出 Mermaid 流程圖或 LaTeX 公式時，終端機被誤判為支援 Kitty 繪圖通訊協定，導致畫面印出整排破圖字元；現在已取消這項假設，改以清晰的 ASCII 純文字備援格式顯示，確保圖表與排版內容都能一目了然。
body.en: When viewing architecture diagrams or mathematical formulas inside WezTerm or the VS Code integrated terminal, you will no longer see confusing rows of corrupted placeholder characters. Previously, when rendering Mermaid flowcharts or LaTeX formulas, these terminals were incorrectly assumed to support the Kitty graphics protocol, causing rows of broken characters to print on screen. Antigravity has removed this assumption and now displays them in a clear ASCII fallback format, ensuring that both diagrams and formatted content remain readable at a glance.

items.original: Fixed Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX rendering as rows of garbled placeholder characters in WezTerm and the VS Code integrated terminal; these terminals are no longer assumed to support Kitty graphics and now show the ASCII fallback

title.zh-TW: 關閉選取即複製後，成品檢視器釋放滑鼠控制並恢復快速鍵
title.en: Artifact Viewer Releases Mouse Capture When Copy on Select Is Disabled, Restoring Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定中關閉選取自動複製功能時，瀏覽產出的檔案內容不再被強制攔截游標動作。過去在 `/config` 裡將 `Copy on Select` 關閉後，成品檢視器依然會捕捉滑鼠事件，使得終端機原生的選取與複製快速鍵無法使用；現在檢視器已不再佔用滑鼠，終端機本身的複製操作能正常運作，按下 `Ctrl+C` 也會如期執行中斷或退出。
body.en: When you disable automatic copy on selection in settings, browsing generated file contents will no longer hijack your cursor actions. Previously, after turning off `Copy on Select` in `/config`, the artifact viewer continued to capture mouse events, preventing the terminal's native selection and copy shortcuts from working. The viewer now releases the mouse so your terminal's built-in copy operations function normally, and pressing `Ctrl+C` properly interrupts or exits as expected.

items.original: Fixed copying text from the artifact viewer when `Copy on Select` is turned off in `/config`: the viewer no longer captures the mouse, so your terminal's own selection and copy shortcut work, and `Ctrl+C` goes back to interrupting or exiting

title.zh-TW: 專案自訂代理支援修復，桌面端與無頭模式皆能正常選用
title.en: Project Custom Agents Fixed Across Desktop App and Headless Runs

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案目錄下配置專屬的輔助角色時，各個執行環境現在都能順利讀取到這些客製化設定。以前放在 `.agents/agents/` 目錄下的專案自訂代理，容易在桌面應用程式建立的工作區、已信任的工作區、使用 `--agent` 參數、以 `-p` 或 `--prompt` 執行的 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式），以及 `/agents` 面板中找不到或無法選取；現在這些辨識問題均已修好，無論在哪種模式下都能直接指派自訂代理。
body.en: When configuring dedicated assistant roles in your project directory, every execution environment can now smoothly load these custom settings. Previously, project custom agents located in `.agents/agents/` were frequently missing or unselectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in trusted workspaces, when specifying `--agent`, in headless `-p` or `--prompt` runs without a terminal window, and within the `/agents` panel. These discovery issues have all been resolved, allowing you to assign custom agents directly in any mode.

items.original: Fixed project custom agents in .agents/agents/ not being found or selectable in workspaces created in the Desktop App, in already-trusted workspaces, under execution with --agent, in headless (-p / --prompt) runs, and in the /agents panel.

entries: **Claude Code plugin: `/usage:quota`.** Run `/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage`, then `/plugin install usage@usage`, and `/usage:quota` shows how much of the Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly quota is used and when each window resets. The plugin only calls `usage-cli status --json` (through `uvx` when `usage-cli` isn't installed). It calls `usage-cli` rather than `usage` because other tools also install a `usage` command, and it runs only when you type it — Claude never triggers it on its own.

**`usage status --json` reports countdowns.** Each window gains `resets_in_seconds` and each agent gains `age_seconds`, both measured at `generated_at`, so consumers no longer subtract timestamps themselves.

**Terse mode drops two lines.** "Never let it fade" pressure is gone — the per-message reminder already keeps the style steady — and so is "no warmth padding", which clashed with the resume handoff's warm recap, the one place every user reads.

**The HTML report's KPI cards stay one height.** The big number on the tokens card shows one rounded value; the exact figure and change move to small lines, so the four cards no longer wrap unevenly. On phones, sections get 16px side padding instead of touching the card edge.

title.zh-TW: Claude Code 新增外掛，對話中直接查額度
title.en: Claude Code Gets a Plugin for Checking Quotas Right in the Conversation

body.zh-TW:
你跟 Claude Code 對話到一半想確認還能問幾題，不必再特地跳出視窗開終端機查帳。⟦像在辦公桌邊裝了計量表，瞄一眼就知道剩餘額度，以前得特地跑去機房看總表，現在坐在位子上就能掌握。⟧只要先後安裝市集與外掛，就能依序在 Claude Code 對話介面輸入以下指令查詢：
```
/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage
/plugin install usage@usage
/usage:quota
```
執行後會列出 Claude Code 與 Codex 的 5 小時及每週額度（quota，模型使用上限）用了多少與何時重置。外掛只呼叫 `usage-cli status --json`，未安裝時會透過 `uvx` 執行。指令使用 `usage-cli` 是為避免與其他工具同名衝突，而且只有你主動輸入才會執行，Claude 絕不會在背景自行觸發。
body.en:
When you're mid-conversation with Claude Code and want to check how many questions you have left, you no longer need to jump out of the window and open a terminal to check your account. ⟦It's like having a meter installed right at your desk: one glance tells you the remaining quota. Before, you had to make a special trip to the server room to read the master gauge; now you can keep track without leaving your seat.⟧ Just install the marketplace and the plugin in order, then enter the following commands in the Claude Code conversation interface:
```
/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage
/plugin install usage@usage
/usage:quota
```
After running, it lists how much of the 5-hour and weekly quotas (the model usage limits) for Claude Code and Codex have been used and when they reset. The plugin only calls `usage-cli status --json`, and runs it via `uvx` if it isn't installed. The command uses `usage-cli` to avoid name clashes with other tools, and it only runs when you type it yourself—Claude will never trigger it on its own in the background.

items.original: **Claude Code plugin: `/usage:quota`.** Run `/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage`, then `/plugin install usage@usage`, and `/usage:quota` shows how much of the Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly quota is used and when each window resets. The plugin only calls `usage-cli status --json` (through `uvx` when `usage-cli` isn't installed). It calls `usage-cli` rather than `usage` because other tools also install a `usage` command, and it runs only when you type it — Claude never triggers it on its own.

title.zh-TW: 狀態查詢回傳倒數秒數，免去手動換算時間
title.en: Status Queries Return Countdown Seconds, No More Manual Time Conversion

body.zh-TW: 打算寫腳本抓取帳號狀態時，串接程式再也不必為了計算剩餘時間而大費周章。⟦好比公車站牌直接標示進站倒數三分鐘，以前只印發車時刻讓乘客自己看手錶心算，現在抬頭就能直接看懂還要等多久。⟧現在執行 `usage status --json` 時，輸出格式直接替你算好倒數時間。每個統計視窗新增了 `resets_in_seconds` 欄位回傳額度重置倒數，每個代理人（agent，負責執行特定任務的 AI 程式）也多了 `age_seconds` 記錄已運作秒數。兩項數值都以報表產生的 `generated_at` 時間點為準計算完成，接收資料的下游工具不用再自己拿兩個時間戳記相減。
body.en: When you plan to write a script to pull account status, the integrating program no longer has to go to great lengths just to calculate remaining time. ⟦Think of a bus stop sign that directly shows "arriving in 3 minutes": before, it only printed departure times and passengers had to check their watches and do the math; now you just look up and immediately see how long the wait is.⟧ Now when you run `usage status --json`, the output format calculates the countdown for you. Each statistics window gains a `resets_in_seconds` field returning the countdown until the quota resets, and each agent (an AI program responsible for a specific task) also gets an `age_seconds` field recording how many seconds it has been running. Both values are computed against the report's `generated_at` timestamp, so downstream tools receiving the data no longer need to subtract two timestamps themselves.

items.original: **`usage status --json` reports countdowns.** Each window gains `resets_in_seconds` and each agent gains `age_seconds`, both measured at `generated_at`, so consumers no longer subtract timestamps themselves.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式移除過度施壓指令，交接語氣更自然
title.en: Terse Mode Drops Overly Pressuring Instructions, Making Handoffs Sound More Natural

body.zh-TW: 使用精簡模式讓 AI 長話短說時，換班交接的開場訊息不再生硬冰冷。⟦像指導實習生寫工作日誌，以前規定字字精簡且嚴禁任何問候，導致交班留言生硬冰冷，現在拿掉死板禁令，既維持精準也能在交接時保有溫暖問候。⟧系統在精簡模式（terse mode，指示 AI 保持回答簡短的設定）中移除了兩行提示詞。首先是刪去「不准淡忘」的嚴格施壓要求，因為每則訊息發送時的提醒機制本來就能穩定簡潔語氣。其次是拿掉「不要為了親切多寫」的禁令，避免它與每位使用者必讀的進度交接摘要互相衝突。
body.en: When using terse mode to make the AI keep things short, the shift-handoff opening message no longer sounds stiff and cold. ⟦Picture coaching an intern on writing a work log: the old rules demanded every word be terse and strictly banned any greeting, which made handoff notes stiff and cold. Now the rigid bans are removed, keeping things precise while still allowing a warm greeting at handoff.⟧ The system removed two lines from the prompt in terse mode (the setting that tells the AI to keep answers short). First, it deleted the strict pressuring demand to "never let it fade," because the reminder mechanism attached to every message already keeps the tone consistently concise. Second, it removed the ban on "writing extra just to be friendly," to avoid conflicting with the progress handoff summary that every user must read.

items.original: **Terse mode drops two lines.** "Never let it fade" pressure is gone — the per-message reminder already keeps the style steady — and so is "no warmth padding", which clashed with the resume handoff's warm recap, the one place every user reads.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表卡片等高對齊，手機排版補上邊界留白
title.en: HTML Report Cards Aligned to Equal Height, Mobile Layout Gains Edge Padding

body.zh-TW: 打開瀏覽器或手機查看用量報表時，畫面中的統計數據不再排列得歪歪斜斜。⟦恰似將畫廊展覽牆上的說明牌統一裁成相同尺寸，以前字數多的卡牌排版混亂且緊貼外框，現在將補充細節縮小分行並留出邊距，整面展示牆看起來整齊一致。⟧在 HTML 報表裡，四張關鍵指標卡的高度現在保持完全一致。記錄 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）消耗的卡片大字只放約略值，精確數值與漲跌幅度則改以小字分行顯示，解決了過去卡片文字換行不一的問題。手機版各區塊也在兩側補上 16px 的留白，內容不再緊貼著卡片邊界。
body.en: When you open the usage report in a browser or on your phone, the statistics on screen no longer line up crookedly. ⟦Like trimming every caption plaque on a gallery wall to the same size: before, cards with more text were laid out messily and pressed against the frame; now the supplementary details are shrunk onto separate lines with margins added, and the whole display wall looks neat and consistent.⟧ In the HTML report, the four key metric cards now all keep exactly the same height. The card tracking token (the unit of text the AI processes and bills by) consumption shows only an approximate value in large type, while the exact figure and the change move to smaller text on separate lines, fixing the old problem of inconsistent line wrapping across cards. On mobile, each section also gains 16px of padding on both sides, so content no longer hugs the card edges.

items.original: **The HTML report's KPI cards stay one height.** The big number on the tokens card shows one rounded value; the exact figure and change move to small lines, so the four cards no longer wrap unevenly. On phones, sections get 16px side padding instead of touching the card edge.

## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. If you installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026 and haven't refreshed your keyring, installs and updates may fail. ⟦It's like a courier switching to a new seal: your building's guard only knows the old one, so packages get turned away until you show the guard what the new seal looks like.⟧ Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and anyone who installed through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼
title.en: gh now copies your login code for you

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.
